How we check

Our rule is simple: we only show a fact if we can point to where it came from. If we can't confirm something, we say "Unknown" rather than guess.

Where the data comes from

  • Which products are listed, and their features: HMRC's software finder for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, using the full list for sole traders and landlords. Last read on 18 November 2026: 179 products. This gives us whether there's a free version, whether it creates records or bridges to spreadsheets, which income sources it supports, what it can submit, MTD for VAT, HMRC Assist, accessibility features and the status of each tax-return item.
  • Prices: read by us on each provider's own pricing page. Each product page shows the date checked and links to the page. We note introductory offers separately from the regular price. So far we've checked 34 products, starting with the best-known names and those people ask about most on forums.
  • Joint property support: shown as "Yes" only when the provider's own site says it splits income and expenses between joint owners. HMRC's finder doesn't record this. See our jointly owned property guide.
  • CIS: "CIS on tax return" is HMRC's status for reporting Construction Industry Scheme deductions on your tax return. It doesn't mean the software files contractor CIS returns.
  • Thresholds and dates: taken directly from GOV.UK and linked wherever they appear.

Order and independence

The directory shows our featured products first. These are products whose providers run an affiliate programme we can join, so featuring them is a commercial decision, not a purely editorial ranking. Every other HMRC-recognised product follows under Best of the rest. Within each group, price-checked products come first, then A to Z, and you can re-sort or filter the whole list yourself. A commission never decides whether a product is listed or what facts we show: every product's details come from HMRC and the provider's own website, checked the same way.

Which pages search engines see

Every HMRC-recognised product has a page, and every page stays linked from the directory. We release product pages to search engines gradually: until a page has information we've checked on the provider's own website, it's kept out of search results, so we don't publish thin pages.

Who checks

This site is run by Daniel Wyatt in the UK, for UK landlords and sole traders. AI helps gather and organise the details, and Daniel Wyatt checks the results before anything is published. About Daniel Wyatt.

Keeping it up to date

We re-read HMRC's list and re-check prices regularly. If you spot something out of date, email customerservices@mtdsoftwarecompare.co.uk and we will correct it.
